name: io.github.ajemba/codasms-mcp
description: Receive one-time SMS/OTP verification codes via the CODASMS API: get a number, wait, release.

environmentVariables.name: CODASMS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your coda_live_ reseller key from https://codasms.com/reseller

environmentVariables.name: CODASMS_MAX_PRICE_CENTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional cap (US cents) — get_number refuses numbers priced above this.
